newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 21.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 21.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Croatian President Franjo Tudjman has begun an official visit to Hungary.
- The Highest Court will decide today if the decisions of a controversial meeting of the opposition party Christian Democrats (KDNP) can take effect.
- Some 26 percent of tax-payers granted one percent of their personal income tax to civil organisations.
- A father detained by the police admitted that he had beaten his nine-month-old son to death.
